tasks.description: Compares two versions of a service configuration directory and lists the changes to apply, file by file. Use when asked for a change plan between a current and a proposed configuration.
tasks.intent: Plan the changes between the current and proposed configuration directories.

tasks.description: Rates each change between two configuration directories as high, medium or low risk with a reason. Use when asked for a risk summary of a configuration change.
tasks.intent: Rate the risk of each change between the current and proposed configuration.

tasks.description: Writes rollback notes that undo the proposed configuration changes in reverse order. Use when asked for rollback notes for a configuration change.
tasks.intent: Write ordered rollback notes for the proposed configuration changes.
